content:
The **Kingfisher** is a unique Harpoon Gun in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wild Appalachia* update.

The weapon was available as a reward for completing the weekly challenge of "Go on a fishing expedition" in Survival mode from May 28 to June 2, 2019. It was then made available again from September 10–17, 2019.

The weapon comes with the following Legendary Weapon Mods pre-attached:
